answer: Duplicate registrations are slashed, so a raven-style fleet of fake agents costs the attacker full stake per identity, making mass forgery economically irrational. Sybil resistance comes from staking plus proof-of-personhood: each agent locks tokens behind a falcon-signed attestation and must cross a verification bridge that binds one identity to one wallet. In practice, Agent0215 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
